A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FCMR benchmark and CMRGen framework. Their main text, tables, figures, and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including material moved between sections.

before.justification: v2 reports original model evaluations on FCMR, MMQA image-withholding experiments, prompt-optimization results, and manual error analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds evaluations of four models in Table 9.

M1.justification: The CMRGen pipeline, statement templates, distractor construction, and inference prompts remain unchanged. Distractor Generation moves from Appendix B.6 to Section 3.3; expanded human-review documentation does not establish a new method component.

E1.justification: The financial data, difficulty tiers, four chart types, MMQA checks, and paraphrasing datasets are retained. Material-CMR was already illustrated in v2 Appendix A. The added models use the existing FCMR Hard evaluation scenario.

E2.justification: Table 9 adds nova-pro-v1, grok-2-vision, qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct, and gemma-3-27b-it to the existing 100-sample Hard comparison. Its previous comparators and the main benchmark comparator set remain.

E3.justification: The zero-shot CoT setup, JSON table inputs, accuracy metric, dataset counts, and reported analysis sample sizes remain unchanged. Table 9 retains its 100 randomly selected Hard samples. Appendix C.1 expands review documentation without establishing a changed evaluation protocol or a rerun.

E4.justification: Appendix C.1 adds quality-inspection evidence: the initial review found Easy and Medium samples satisfactory, while 22 of 714 Hard samples required revision. Existing chart-type, reasoning-stage, error-category, and prompt-optimization analyses remain; moving chart interpretability from Appendix E to Section 6.2 is not a new analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for the model results. The expanded human-review account does not introduce statistical uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: New Table 9 entries report 22% for nova-pro-v1 and 19% each for grok-2-vision, qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct, and gemma-3-27b-it. Existing performance entries remain unchanged, including o1 at 43%. Figure 1 replaces the 100% FCMR pie with a 34.4%/33.1%/32.5% split, and Appendix C.1 newly quantifies Hard-sample revisions as 22/714.

T1.justification: Neither version introduces formal theorems, proofs, or derivations. Statement templates and reasoning-stage descriptions are retained; the three-hop clarification is conceptual rather than a change to formal mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: v3 qualifies the blanket three-hop characterization in v2 Section 3.4 and Table 12. It distinguishes Hard three-hop reasoning from Easy/Medium instances that still require using all three modalities. The principal benchmark, framework, and information-retrieval bottleneck claims remain.

C2.justification: New Section 3.6 supports the financial realism of the retained chart types using Christensen et al.'s reported visualization frequencies and approximately 98% coverage. v3 also clarifies modality coverage versus reasoning depth. Existing failure interpretations and limitations remain, including the relocated chart-interpretability discussion.

D1.justification: v3 adds a dataset-access link in the introduction. Appendix C.1 newly specifies an initial 10% review across difficulty levels and two-author cross-checking of revisions. These clarify an existing review process; the PDFs do not establish that the revisions occurred between versions.

R1.justification: v3 adds Christensen et al. on visualization in 10-K filings and references associated with Amazon, xAI, Qwen2.5, and Gemma 3. The main related-work discussion and positioning against MMQA remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Localized rewrites clarify difficulty and human review. Distractor generation and chart interpretability move into the main text, chart-type coverage receives a new subsection, and acknowledgments are added. Most prose and the overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is revised, several figures are enlarged, and paraphrasing-quality and contamination tables move from the appendix into the main text. Table 7 reorders columns, Table 9 adds rows, and captions including Figure 22 and Table 12 are expanded. The remaining figure content is retained.

improvement.justification: v3 improves clarity by distinguishing three-hop reasoning from merely using three modalities, makes dataset quality more assessable through the expanded review account, and supplies a dataset-access pointer. Table 9 modestly broadens empirical support. These are useful, limited gains; the underlying method and principal experimental findings remain unchanged.
